description: Neoforge updated version of Eternal Winter, A mod for minecraft that enables snow in every biome.

mods.name: Eternal Christmas
mods.description: Makes the world eternally snowy & winter themed.

releases.notes:
# **Changelog – v1.0.0**

### **Initial Release**

* Added global snowfall mechanic, enabling **snow in every biome**, regardless of temperature.
* Implemented compatibility with **NeoForge 1.21.1**.
* Ensured natural weather cycles remain unchanged—only expanded snow generation rules.
* Optimized performance to avoid lag during weather updates.
* Added basic configuration structure for future customization options.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/NullOnRise/EternalChristmas/commits/1.0
